cases.name: coherent_control
cases.source_basis: Frozen independently authored schema baseline; no native execution claim.

cases.name: bound_generation_never_connected
cases.source_basis: peer_lifecycle.connected allocates generation; admitted and peer_bound use the same pending attempt. Connected generation1 cannot bind generation2 without another connected event.

cases.name: bound_peer_never_connected
cases.source_basis: Only peer71 has connected; peer72 binding cannot be admitted from its nonexistent lifecycle entry.

cases.name: binding_before_connection
cases.source_basis: begin_join/current/admitted require the lifecycle entry created by connected before any binding.

cases.name: same_generation_rebound_to_other_actor
cases.source_basis: Match._join_rpc returns when _peer_actors.has(peer_id); the same live peer/generation cannot bind another actor.

cases.name: first_accept_before_first_receive
cases.source_basis: First input_received always precedes first input_accepted within the synchronous _input_rpc body; its first transition emits before any acceptance.

cases.name: one_command_two_sequence_endpoints
cases.source_basis: _native_input_packet first and last derive from the same sole command when count1. A positive increasing interval alone is insufficient.

cases.name: welcome_claims_unobserved_attempt
cases.source_basis: diagnostic.attempt increments only in client_attempt, which always emits. A single observed/counted attempt cannot yield local_attempt2 at welcome.

cases.name: accepted_unordered_two_command_batch
cases.source_basis: SBInputStream.accept validates each command and stages a dictionary; it imposes no array ordering. Valid commands22 and20 can be accepted, then pop consumes20. Header first/last are array endpoints, not minimum/maximum. This is a valid projection, not evidence of native execution.
